Those two files are actually the Interim Budget 2024-25 vintage. Their columns are Actuals 2022-23, BE 2023-24, RE 2023-24 and BE 2024-25; there is no 2023-24 Actual. An ingest unit following the plan would silently load 2022-23 actuals and 2023-24 revised estimates as if they were 2023-24 actuals. ntr.xls also has no dividends-by-enterprise breakdown, only 'Dividends from Public Sector Enterprises' and the RBI line, so it cannot serve as the DPE/R7 substitute the plan describes.

Add a header check in the unit that fails unless the column reads 'Actual 2023-2024'. For dividends by enterprise type, point R7 and the DPE substitute to Finance Accounts Statement 8 MH 0050 minor heads 101/106/107/108/109/200 plus Statement 11, not ntr.xls. Log the stale .xls in ISSUES.md.

access_check_issues.location: ACCESS_PLAN.md s.5 row mospi_asuse_unit_data and s.4 row mospi_asuse; access_plan.csv row mospi_asuse_unit_data
access_check_issues.problem: The substitute for V2a/F3c is overstated. The plan says the ASUSE report tables and API give 'ownership type x activity x R/U; GVA and emoluments per worker'. In fact every published ownership table is a count of establishments, and every published GVA table is by establishment type (OAE/HWE), never by ownership type. So the proprietary-vs-partnership share of operating surplus cannot be read from published tables at any aggregation. It has to be imputed from establishment-count shares.
access_check_issues.suggested_fix: State the imputation explicitly: the proprietary/partnership split of OS by activity group is taken from establishment-count shares, possibly weighted by the OAE/HWE GVA per establishment. Widen the V2a/F3c bands and log it in ISSUES.md.
access_check_issues.evidence: ASUSE 2023-24 full report (200, 17,207,885 B, 1,280 pages): ownership appears only in Statement 7/8 and Table 6/7 ('Per 1000 distribution of establishments by type of ownership'). GVA appears in Tables 35-38 ('by establishment type ... market establishments'). API asuse/getAsuseIndicatorListByFrequency: indicators 3/4 are 'Per 1000 Distribution of Establishments by Type of Ownership'; 30-35 are per-worker/per-establishment emoluments and GVA, with no ownership dimension.
